# Code of Conduct — Foundation Solo

## Our standard

Everyone participating in Foundation Solo discussions, code reviews, documentation, and community channels is expected to act respectfully and constructively.

Expected behavior includes welcoming questions in good faith; discussing technical ideas on their merits; providing specific, actionable feedback; respecting different experience levels and backgrounds; honoring privacy and consent; and accepting corrections with professionalism.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, threats, discriminatory attacks, sexualized misconduct, intimidation, repeated personal attacks, publication of private information without permission, and deliberate disruption of project collaboration.

## Scope and moderation

This policy applies to project-controlled contribution and communication spaces. Maintainers may remove inappropriate content, close discussions, restrict participation, or escalate severe misconduct as necessary, proportionately and consistently.

To report conduct concerns confidentially, use the maintainer contact mechanism once designated in this repository. The Owner must establish a workable confidential conduct-reporting contact **before opening public collaboration**. Do not assume an unverified GitHub setting or mailbox exists.

This is an original project policy draft for Owner review, not an assertion that maintainers or reporting channels have already been appointed.
